Login.// note: Per client IP (IPv6 grouped by /64). Successful logins count too, so this must clear a whole office signing in at 09:00 through one NAT or proxy address. Brute force is stopped by the per-account throttle, not by this number.

PublicApply.// note: Public job page + application form. Higher than login: a link shared to Facebook produces a real burst of views from one office or campus address.

AI.// note: Optional per ADR-0008. Leave ApiKey empty and the AI endpoints return 402 — the feature is simply off. EnableFallback serves fabricated sample profiles and match scores instead, and belongs in appsettings.Development.json only: a recruiter cannot tell a stub from a real analysis, and a confirmed parsed profile is written to the candidate record. Once a key is set, a provider that errors returns 502; it never falls back.

ReverseProxy.// note: Set true ONLY when the API is unreachable except through the proxy. If the API port is published, X-Forwarded-For is attacker-controlled and defeats the per-IP limiter.

BulkResume.// note: Bulk CV upload runs on the same durable queue as outbound mail (ADR-0026). Defaults suit one instance per company. MaxFileSizeBytes and MaxFilesPerBatch are enforced at upload, before anything is stored. Keep BatchSize x slowest-extraction well inside VisibilityTimeout — a pass that outlives it means the same CV is parsed twice and the candidate is created twice. Allowed file types are NOT configurable: they are what the extractor can actually read.

Smtp.// note: REQUIRED for any install that sends mail — interview invitations, offers, reminders, scheduled reports (ADR-0026). Leave Host empty and every queued message retries to its cap and lands Failed with 'no mail server configured' in the delivery log; nothing is silently dropped and nothing pretends to have been sent. Password is a secret: set it from the environment (Smtp__Password), never here. Port 465 implicit TLS is NOT supported — use 587 with STARTTLS.
